songs.title: Free Air
songs.verdict: A soft-focus plugg single that leans into the hazy, pluggnb side of the Russian underground instead of the loud end of it.
songs.body:
Sir Soylok is a Kurgan-born, Saint Petersburg-based rapper working in plugg, pluggnb and cloud rap.
"Free Air" is a standalone single with a video, going for a floaty, atmospheric mood.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (international plugg). ~14K Spotify monthly listeners. Out Oct 23, 2026 per Spotify. Covered in Erik Pérou's Weekly Wrap Up Oct 19-25: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-19th-2026-oct. Spotify verified by fetch. Source also lists YouTube _5pQ0TAC2Sk and SoundCloud, not verified.

songs.title: FACE
songs.verdict: Glitchy, house-leaning pop rap that sits closer to the club than the trap house, in a lane few rappers are working.
songs.body:
CONNIE is a Rockford, Illinois-born, LA-based artist known for pairing his music with AI-assisted videos.
"FACE" mixes pop rap with electro and fidget house and glitch hop, and comes with a video.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane, leans club. ~78K Spotify monthly listeners (under the cutoff but the biggest rap pick). Out Oct 5, 2026. Source: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-sept-28th-2026-oct. Spotify verified by fetch.

songs.title: A GOOD AND LONG TIME
songs.verdict: A sprawling London record that moves between UK drill, jerk, rage and afro trap, betting on range over one signature sound.
songs.body:
N4T is a London rapper working across UK drill, jerk, rage and afro trap.
A GOOD AND LONG TIME is a 15-track album with lots of collaborators, mixing those styles with conscious and experimental rap.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (UK). ~34K Spotify monthly listeners. Out Oct 16, 2026. Source: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-12th-2026-oct. Entered as album since no standout track was named. Spotify album verified by fetch.

songs.title: Forever An Angel
songs.verdict: A 15-track underground tape where pluggnb haze, rage and glitchy digicore textures all fight for space.
songs.body:
uziellsiilver is an underground artist working in plugg, pluggnb, cloud rap and glitch pop, releasing since 2023.
Forever An Angel is a 15-track album with features from shxrda and leahsdeathbed.
songs.scout_note: Rap/digicore crossover. ~24K Spotify monthly listeners. Out Oct 16, 2026 (Spotify fetched). Source: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-26th-2026-nov, which names the title track and 'rawr xd' as standouts. Two scouts disagreed on hometown (Mexico vs Atlanta), so it's left out of the body; check. Apple/SoundCloud links unverified, left blank.

songs.title: 我只想當個Swagger (I Just Wanna Be Swagger)
songs.verdict: A Chengdu rage-and-jerk record that pulls from Chicago drill, plugg and hyperpop, a fresh angle on lanes usually tied to US and UK scenes.
songs.body:
Siky Revange is a rapper from Chengdu, China, working in rage, plugg, pluggnb and jerk.
The 11-track album mixes in drill, trap and hyperpop touches, with a feature from acid souljah.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (China). Very small: ~8.6K Spotify monthly listeners. Out Oct 24, 2026. Sources: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-19th-2026-oct and the Oct 12 wrap-up. Standouts named there: 'bbb', 'trap music'. Buzz is mostly niche curator circles. Spotify verified by fetch.

songs.title: Just Passin' Thru
songs.verdict: A grimy Florida tape that sits between dirty-south trap, gangsta rap and plugg, a no-frills regional entry next to the stranger picks.
songs.body:
509 BMG is an underground rap act from Orlando, Florida.
Just Passin' Thru is a project of dirty-south trap with gangsta rap and plugg elements.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (Florida). Smallest pick: ~7.8K Spotify monthly listeners. Out Oct 19, 2026. Source: https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-26th-2026-nov. Thin evidence of buzz; unclear if solo or group. Spotify verified by fetch.

songs.title: openinghearts
songs.verdict: Surf Gang's chaos duo take a Euro-trance anthem and blow it out with static, the kind of warped party music they keep sharpening.
songs.body:
B0YG1RL is the Miami duo of June Vinette and Angela Rio, mixing Miami bass, baile funk and hyperpop on Surf Gang Records.
"openinghearts" is half of a new double single made with Surf Gang producer 4evr, with a video by Cass Morrison.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Stereogum Nov 9, 2026: https://stereogum.com/2517160/b0yg1rl-i-dont-recall-openinghearts/music ; FADER feature May 2026. ~44K Spotify monthly listeners, indie label. YouTube verified via oEmbed (B0YG1RL channel). Also dropped a self-titled album Oct 1 and the single 'MOND LAN FINI' Sep 17 (https://open.spotify.com/track/2J5vKGVQ05dpdadZwDvEid) if you'd rather review those.

songs.title: Alternative Rock Music
songs.verdict: A straight shot of dariacore: hyper-fast sample-flip chaos from one of the names the scene's own chroniclers point to.
songs.body:
ta1lsd0ll is a New Jersey producer in the dariacore/hyperflip scene, known for Sonic-themed release series.
"Alternative Rock Music" is a name-your-price Bandcamp single built from flipped samples.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane (dariacore). Out Sep 18, 2026 per official Bandcamp (fetched; it links instagram.com/ta1lsd0ll). Very underground; not on Spotify/Apple. YouTube link is a fan upload on 'pibbs music emporium' (title confirmed via oEmbed), so prefer Bandcamp. Scene context: https://www.chsperiscope.com/ae/2026/02/17/a-deep-dive-into-the-dariacore-hyperflip-scene/

songs.title: (L)ove (I)s (F)or (E)veryone
songs.verdict: Breakneck euro-dance-pop pitched as an antifascist statement, a 17-track sprint aimed at the club.
songs.body:
Mietze Conte is an Austrian electropop artist on Sumoclic, the Brisbane label co-founded by 1tbsp.
The album is billed as antifascist, led by the club single 'painting on a monument', with 1tbsp on 'lavender'.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Out Oct 29, 2026, 17 tracks (Spotify fetched). Line of Best Fit announcement: https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/mietze-conte-announces-new-album-love-is-for-everyone. Indie (Sumoclic). CHECK LISTENER COUNT: she tours UK/EU festivals and could be over 100k. Apple/SoundCloud links unverified, left blank.

songs.title: New Pop Standard
songs.verdict: A maximalist glitch-pop cut, pulled from a sprawling 37-track album, that treats internet-pop clichés as raw material.
songs.body:
lilbesh ramko is an internet hyperpop/digicore artist with a cult following, including in Japanese fan circles.
"New Pop Standard" comes from Ramko Helvetica, a 37-track album tagged hyperpop, digicore, glitch pop and jersey club.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Out Oct 10, 2026 (Spotify track fetched; album https://open.spotify.com/album/44yRfLuIoWA3ia9hHeNdPO). Source: idontknowerik.substack.com Sep 28-Oct 4 wrap-up. No label info or listener count; may be bigger than the others, check.

songs.title: universal will
songs.verdict: Lo-fi, pitched-voice bedroom electronics from a cult name, and the title track of an album said to push into harder guitar-and-drums territory.
songs.body:
katie dey is an Australian bedroom-pop songwriter whose warped, pitched vocals have a cult following among hyperpop and digicore fans.
"universal will" is the title track of her new album, out Nov 6, 2026.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop-adjacent lane. Album out Nov 6, 2026; Stereogum announcement: https://stereogum.com/2514199/katie-dey-announces-new-album-universal-will-hear-for-you/music. YouTube lyric video on her official channel, confirmed via oEmbed (from 50percenthipster's Nov 6 NMF). Bandcamp link is the album page, taken from Stereogum. Veteran cult act rather than a new name; listener count unverified but likely small.

songs.title: r u?
songs.verdict: A small, yearning R&B vocal that landed a COLORS slot within days of release, proof the quiet approach still cuts through.
songs.body:
nomi. is a new R&B singer on Earth Angel Records.
"r u?" comes from the album this wolf may cry, produced by Zach Ezzy and Adam Krevlin.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Studio track out Oct 30, 2026 (Spotify fetched). COLORS show Oct 26; FADER 'Songs You Need' Oct 28: https://www.thefader.com/2026/10/28/songs-you-need-in-your-life-october-28-2026. Very small (Audiomack ~5K plays). YouTube link is the COLORS performance embedded on FADER, not the studio version.

songs.title: Way Back To You
songs.verdict: Cut-up vocal samples and drum-first rhythms push this Swedish left-of-center R&B project somewhere messier and livelier.
songs.body:
Becky and the Birds is the project of Swedish singer-producer Thea Gustafsson, making left-of-center pop with R&B roots.
"Way Back To You" is built from rhythms and cut-up vocal samples recorded in California with longtime collaborator Nick Velez.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Stereogum Nov 6, 2026: https://stereogum.com/2516783/becky-and-the-birds-way-back-to-you/music (video embedded there). Also on Line of Best Fit's New Music Discovery, Nov 6. CHECK LISTENER COUNT and label: established in alt-R&B circles, could be near 100k. No Spotify link verified.

songs.title: Love's Arp
songs.verdict: Bandcamp's writers call him a generational talent, and this record pulls '90s R&B and glitchy neo-soul apart into ghostly spirituals.
songs.body:
Dawuna is Baltimore artist Ian Mugerwa, who writes and produces his own records; this is his first album for True Panther.
Love's Arp mixes gospel harmonies, East African percussion and falsetto on songs about romantic, spiritual and family love.
songs.scout_note: R&B/neo-soul lane. Bandcamp Daily Essential Releases Nov 6, 2026: https://daily.bandcamp.com/essential-releases/essential-releases-november-6-2026 (highlights 'Be Careful II'). Apple album fetched: Nov 6, 2026, True Panther (indie), 13 tracks. Listener count unknown, likely small.

songs.title: Playtime
songs.verdict: A '90s-leaning R&B single built for slow-burn replay rather than big moments.
songs.body:
Crystal Tamar is an independent R&B singer.
"Playtime" is a '90s-style R&B single produced by Young Fyre.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Out Oct 23, 2026 (Spotify fetched). Found via an EARMILK post dated Nov 2, 2026. Thin background info; check listener count and bio.

songs.title: Over
songs.verdict: A Paris club producer known for tribal techno and speed dembow takes a first swing at dubstep, aimed squarely at soundsystems.
songs.body:
Amor Satyr is a Paris-based producer and DJ from the DIY bass scene, co-founder of WAJANG, with releases on SSPB and TraTraTrax.
"Over" opens Judder Vinyl Series Vol. 2, a compilation of raw, soundsystem-focused experimental bass.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. Mixmag premiere Oct 4, 2026 (SoundCloud embed): https://mixmag.net/read/new-music-on-our-radar-this-week-blackhaine-horsegiirl-dj-heartstring-news. Judder Bandcamp: released Oct 23, 2026. SoundCloud upload is Mixmag's account, not the artist's. Club-circuit DJ, well under 100k.

songs.title: PLAYTHEDRUMS
songs.verdict: A bedroom-pop songwriter heads for the club, mixing '80s textures, hazy bass and airy vocals into something kitschy on purpose.
songs.body:
Skateland is Dorian Williams II, a Las Vegas-raised, New York-based musician and producer who has opened for Foster the People.
"PLAYTHEDRUMS" opens the six-track EP Ultra Kitsch, written with dancing and clubs in mind.
songs.scout_note: Indie/bedroom pop lane. Atwood Weekly Roundup Nov 6, 2026 (YouTube embed): https://atwoodmagazine.com/?p=231598 ; Melodic Magazine Nov 2 (source of IG): https://www.melodicmag.com/news/new-music/skateland-finds-the-happy-medium-between-past-and-future-nostalgia-on-visceral-ep-ultra-kitsch/. Exact release date not confirmed (coverage starts Nov 2). Listener count unknown, likely small.
